data_notes: This feature is a pure utility addition — no persistence layer changes. It adds one exported function ResourcePrefix(value string) (string, bool) to internal/id/resource.go and corresponding table-driven tests to internal/id/resource_test.go. No new tables, no new repositories, no new files, no migrations, no configuration changes. The function reuses existing HasResourceShape and the seven Prefix* constants (PrefixInstance, PrefixImage, PrefixKeyPair, PrefixTask, PrefixVPC, PrefixSubnet, PrefixNetworkInterface) to extract the prefix from a well-formed resource ID. Transaction contract: N/A — no writes, no database access.
